page.hero_subtitle: Makanan sebenar, orang sebenar, cerita sebenar
page.hero_description: We're not tour operators. We're your temporary neighbours. For 14+ years, we've been walking guests through neighbourhoods where we grew up eating, introducing them to vendors who've become family, and sharing the Malaysia we treasure. Where would you like to start?
page.intro_description: Browse tours by location, dietary preference, or group type. All tours include 8-10+ tastings, local guides, and stories you won't find in guidebooks.
page.signature_tours_subtext: 5 lawatan yang memulakan segalanya. Setiap satu dibina sekitar peniaga yang kami kenali sejak lebih sedekad. Makcik dan pakcik yang telah menjadi keluarga kami sendiri.
page.tours_by_city_subtext: Setiap bandar di Malaysia menceritakan kisah makanan yang berbeza. Nenek Cina di Penang, tradisi kampung Melayu di KL, gabungan Peranakan berusia 600 tahun di Melaka. Pilih bab anda.
